newsitem.title: MEXICO: Pemex details 1996 petroleum products sale.
newsitem.headline: Pemex details 1996 petroleum products sale.

text.p: Mexico produced 1.48 million barrels per day (bpd) of petroleum products in 1996, state oil and gas monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) said Wednesday in a statement.
Pemex's petroleum products garnered 87.981 billion pesos in 1996, a 48.9 percent increase in revenues from the previous year.

The company's refining division saw sales of 480,600 bpd of its three brands of gasoline, an improvement from the previous year but still below 1994 levels. Diesel sales totalled an average 243,900 bpd.
Pemex said it sold nationally in 1996 an average 265,400 bpd of liquified petroleum gas (LPG), 44,900 bpd of jet fuel, and 411,200 bpd of fuel oil.
In petroleum products such as kerosenes, asphalts, greases and lubricants, the company said it sold an average 35,400 bpd in 1996.
